resources.string: When this address cannot be reached, these are tried in order. A host on Rex\'s port is tried only on Rex\'s ports, and a TLS host only over TLS.
When this address cannot be reached, these are tried in order, with the same account and key. Every one must show the host key trusted for this host.
Another kind of address than this host\'s: never tried
Plain text for a TLS host: never tried
The public key could not be read from this key. An encrypted key needs its passphrase.
The new key signs in only once its public key is in the host\'s authorized_keys. The old key is gone after Save.
Add this to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the host. It is the public half only; the private key stays on this phone.
